description: This file defines a custom report class for generating product price and cost structure reports in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including methods for processing bill of materials and work centers, and producing XML report output.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class inheriting from report_rml, responsible for creating XML reports of product prices and cost structures.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Main method to generate the XML report, processing BOMs and work centers, and assembling the report content.
